tagline: Report once. Route right. Resolve faster.

theme_strategy.theme_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL CIVIC WAR ROOM
theme_strategy.concept: Palantir-grade Civic Command HUD meets warm, accessible citizen portal. Dark slate foundation (#0B132B / #1C2541) with high-visibility tactical status indicators (Amber #F59E0B, Emerald #10B981, Crimson #EF4444, Cyber Cyan #06B6D4). Always features 'Prototype / Mock Municipal System' banner.

font_genres.headings: Cabinet Grotesk / Barlow Condensed (Tight tracking, authoritative, command-center precision)
font_genres.body: Inter / DM Sans (High legibility at dense tabular data and mobile screens)
font_genres.monospace_metrics: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro (SLA timers, ticket IDs SWC-2026-10482, lat/long coordinates 22.7196,75.8577)

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

colors.contrast_rules: All normal text must meet 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio. Text on overlays requires subtle black gradient masks (from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous 2x padding: p-6, p-8, p-12 for dashboard panels and mobile cards to avoid content density collision.

layout_modes.desktop_command_center: Collapsible left sidebar (w-64 expanded / w-16 collapsed), sticky top HUD header with prototype banner, fluid multi-column Bento grid for KPI widgets, GIS Map, and AI Priority Queue.
layout_modes.mobile_citizen: Mobile-first full-width viewport (max-w-md mx-auto on desktop wrapper), fixed top header with back buttons, bottom tab navigation bar for quick access (Report, Track, Map, Demo).

layout_and_spacing.grid_border_style: Exposed grid skeleton with border-r border-b border-slate-800/80 and glow highlights on active state.

component_guidelines.navigation: Top Header MUST display prominent 'Prototype / Mock Municipal System' badge in amber pill tag. Mobile bottom navigation bar for quick citizen flow.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or crisp rectangular buttons with subtle inner light border (border-white/10) and interactive transform hover (hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0).
component_guidelines.cards: Cardless or subtle 1px border cards (bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 backdrop-blur-md). Avoid generic box shadows.
component_guidelines.inputs_and_forms: Use custom styled Shadcn primitives (Input, Select, Textarea, Dialog) with explicit dark state styling and active glowing ring (ring-2 ring-cyan-500/50).
component_guidelines.charts: Recharts with custom tooltips, dark slate background (#0F172A), neon color-blind friendly lines (Cyan #06B6D4, Amber #F59E0B, Emerald #10B981).

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, KPI numbers, and navigation items MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='report-issue-btn', data-testid='kpi-total-complaints', data-testid='sidebar-toggle').
testing_and_accessibility.prototype_badge_rule: The header/banner must explicitly state 'Prototype / Mock Municipal System' across all pages.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always display 'Prototype / Mock Municipal System' banner/badge prominently.
Ensure every interactive component has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Do not use transparent background on dropdowns, headers, or overlays — use backdrop-blur with minimum 70% opacity bg fill.
Avoid using Space Grotesk font, #1B93A4, or #7351B7.
Ensure smooth transition animations for pipeline steps, tabs, and collapsible sidebars without universal transition: all.
Include responsive layouts for both desktop war-room dashboard and mobile-first citizen views.
